description: Show the loan history Priors posted for an agent on the ERC-8004 reputation registry (Robinhood Chain): loans repaid on time, repaid late and defaulted, and loans outstanding, from Priors' credit statements (the erc8004-credit/v1 profile). Each statement is read from its own transaction and checked here: its bytes and hash, the chain of statements, and a sample of its loans against the pools' logs. The totals are Priors' claims checked on that sample, up to the last statement (the answer gives its block and date; later loans are not checked here); the answer gives the command that rebuilds every loan. Read-only.
name: credit_history
title: Priors' ERC-8004 credit statements for an agent
